answer: Sybil resistance by bonded lottery weight: at epoch open an identity locks a ferrous stake and commits a hash; midway, a global beacon drops at its zenith and only commitments hashing below the threshold earn voting weight that epoch. Weight scales with bonded capital, not headcount: a fleet spread across a terrace of identity tiers cannot concentrate its budget behind whichever identity the beacon favors — clones dilute the same pooled stake, and every duplicate pays the full lock again.
